text:
maya: hey all — i'm maya (joined platform today). quick onboarding ask: who do i ping for VPN, AD group (svc-infra), prod DB read-only, PagerDuty invite, and KMS access? also, if a rollout triggers perf alerts who owns escalation?
sam: welcome! short map: infra-team -> VPN/AD, data-team -> DB access, security -> KMS, ops -> PagerDuty. rollouts: eng-runtime owns the rollout plan; eng-sre is first responder for perf alerts.
eli: for DBs file an `infra-access` ticket with DB name + justification. PagerDuty invites are handled by `pd-admins`. If alert is deploy-related, tag #release-war-room and @eng-sre.
priya: ping me for PD invites and if you need expedited Dedicated approvals. KMS requests need key path + business justification + owner approval in the ticket.
gwen: FYI if this is a high-risk change (quantization, kernel, infra) pre-announce to eng-runtime and eng-sre and schedule canary windows.
maya: thanks — is there a tiny template i can paste into the ticket? subject + required fields?
sam: use this snippet as the ticket body: `Access Request
- resource: <name>
- environment: prod/staging
- access level: read/write
- duration: <end date>
- justification: <reason>
- owner/approver: <name>
- related PR or incident: <link>` set priority = onboarding for faster routing.
oncall-bot: reminder: emergency access must include `incident_id:INC-xxxx` and urgency. See https://redwood.internal/ops/access for the incident access flow.
maya: perfect. one more: who mediates if eng-runtime and eng-sre disagree on rollout safety?
eli: product-ops coordinates cross-team disputes. For urgent disagreements start the incident flow and assign a coordinator; for normal disputes open a triage ticket and request a product-ops sync. unresolved after 24h -> escalates to leadership.
gwen: welcome again! :wave: DM me and i'll introduce you to infra leads.
maya: will do — thanks everyone :smile:
